ivan-defranceski.whose: **Ivan Defranceski, 17 December 1951 – 2026**, generation 7 of the direct line and the compiler's father. Three photographs across sixty years: the shore at about a year old, a studio sitting as a young man, and a portrait made on **12 April 2012**.
ivan-defranceski.note: **Only the last of the three is dated by anything better than a face.** *See each caption for what its date rests on.*
